packageRules.description: Bundle every minor and patch update into one weekly PR, auto-merged when CI passes
Major updates get their own PR and always wait for review
.NET major versions (SDK images, Microsoft.* packages) need manual review
Next.js minor releases can change behaviour, so review them
Never offer .NET major versions for the Docker base images: they must change together with TargetFramework in the .csproj files, as a planned upgrade
Hold TypeScript below 7 until typescript-eslint supports the TS 7 API (https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/issues/10940). Remove this rule then.
Hold EF Core on 10.x until Npgsql's EF Core provider has a stable 11.x (it only has release candidates). When the Npgsql 11 PR appears, delete this rule in that PR so EF Core moves with it
Npgsql's EF Core provider majors track EF Core, so flag that EF Core must move in the same PR
packageRules.groupName: Npgsql and EF Core major upgrade
prBodyNotes: EF Core is held on 10.x by a rule in renovate.json. Delete that rule in this PR and bump every Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore* package (and dotnet-ef) to the same major, or the build will fail.

Regenerates package-lock.json so dependencies-of-dependencies (where most npm vulnerabilities hide) get updated. If CI fails or the app misbehaves, just close this PR; next week's refresh will try again.
